verdict.rationale: Number portability is a fair question for a business phone platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only porting numbers in ("new or ported phone number") and a general "cancel anytime" trial policy. It says nothing about porting numbers out, port-out or lock-in fees, or in-app access to the account number or transfer PIN a gaining carrier needs.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my number out without lock-in fees, with the account details the gaining carrier needs available in the app
